files.description: Full HTML of the Varian FHIR R4 API documentation page from DynamicFHIR portal. Contains USCDI-to-FHIR resource mapping table, Bulk Export instructions, client configuration details, OAuth 2.0 flows, and example responses. This is the (g)(10) API documentation, not (b)(10) EHI export documentation.

Full-page screenshot of the FHIR API documentation page rendered in Chrome. Shows the complete documentation including sidebar navigation, FHIR mapping table, bulk export section, and all code examples.

FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement from the Varian DynamicFHIR server. Lists 27 supported resource types with their search parameters and supported interactions. Machine-readable artifact documenting the FHIR API's capabilities.

SMART on FHIR well-known configuration from the Varian DynamicFHIR server. Lists supported OAuth 2.0 scopes (revealing all FHIR resource types accessible via the API), authorization endpoints, and SMART capabilities.

ONC Certification certificate for ARIA CORE v18.3 (2 pages). Shows product name, version, certification date (11/26/2025), CHPL number, certified criteria list, and additional software used (including Dynamic Health IT). This is the mandatory disclosures document, not EHI-specific documentation.

ARIA Interoperability Brochure (5 pages, Nov 2020). Marketing material about ARIA + Epic integration via HL7 interfaces and Varian Professional Services. Describes HL7/DICOM interoperability capabilities but does not contain EHI export technical documentation.

Screenshot of the CHPL listing's 170.315(b)(10) criteria details showing: Relied Upon Software = Winzip, Conformance Method = Attestation, Export Documentation = https://varian.com/aria/ehi (dead URL).
